title: Regression in v1.49.0 when showing layered altair chart in dialog - tooltips not showing when a facet option is specified
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues. - [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue. - [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue. ### Summary I have encountered a regression in how layered altair charts are displayed in dialogs in 1.49.0 vs how they worked in 1.48.0. If you specify a facet (`color`, `strokeWidth`, ...) in the chart encoding, tooltips only show up for the last layer in the chart and the other layers no longer show a tooltip. This only happens for dialogs and not for showing the chart in the page regularly. If you remove the facet encoding (`color` for example), it works correctly, but this means that we would need to have as many chart layers as we have variables, which is quite inconvenient and breaks how altair usually expects data to be fed to it. ### Reproducible Code Example [![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-12390) ```Python import streamlit as st import pandas as pd import altair as alt def _create_chart(): """ Same chart code for both page and dialog """ df = pd.DataFrame( { "x": [1, 2, 3], "y": [4, 5, 6], "y2": [1, 2, 3], # in this case, having a facet encoding doesn't make sense, but usually we'd have multiple kpis here "kpi": ["kpi1", "kpi1", "kpi1"], } ) chart1 = ( alt.Chart(df) .mark_line(point=alt.OverlayMarkDef(size=80)) .encode(x="x", y="y", color="kpi", tooltip=["x", "y"]) .interactive() ) chart2 = ( alt.Chart(df) .mark_area() .encode(x="x", y="y2", color="kpi", tooltip=["x", "y2"]) ) chart = alt.layer(chart1, chart2) return chart [USER].dialog("Dialog with Chart", width="large") def show_dialog(): # show the chart in the dialog chart = _create_chart() st.altair_chart(chart) # show the chart in the page chart = _create_chart() st.altair_chart(chart) show_dialog_btn = st.button("Show Dialog") if show_dialog_btn: show_dialog() ``` ### Steps To Reproduce 1. Hover over both layers in the page chart, make sure both are showing up 2. Click on the "Show Dialog" button 3. Hover over both layers in the dialog, only the area chart tooltip shows up ### Expected Behavior Tooltips should show up for all layers for both page and dialog ### Current Behavior Only the tooltip for the last layer in the layered chart in the dialog is shown ### Is this a regression? - [x] Yes, this used to work in a previous version. ### Debug info - Streamlit version: 1.49.0, 1.49.1 - Python version: 3.12 - Operating System: MacOS - Browser: Safari, Chrome, Firefox ### Additional Information _No response_

This is a confirmed regression in v1.49.0 affecting tooltips in layered Altair charts when displayed inside `st.dialog`. According to the issue investigation, the root cause has been identified as an **upstream bug in the `vega-embed` library** - specifically the upgrade from version 6.29.0 to 7.0.2 introduced in [#11580](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11580). The bug only manifests when charts are rendered in dialogs with facet encodings (like `color`), where tooltips work only for the last layer instead of all layers. Charts rendered on the main page work correctly.

A workaround has been identified: rolling back `vega-embed` to version 6.29.0 fixes the issue. A contributor has volunteered to submit a PR with the rollback and report the issue upstream to the vega-embed team.

### Related Issues

1. **[#8643](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/8643)** - Support chart selections for multi-view vega-lite & altair charts - Related to interactivity issues with layered/multi-view Altair charts, though focused on selections rather than tooltips.

2. **[#6099](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/6099)** - `st.altair_chart` removes data from a compound plot with interaction - Related to compound/layered charts with interactive features not rendering correctly in Streamlit.

3. **[#7994](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/7994)** - `add_rows()` silently fails on compound altair chart - Related to issues with compound/layered Altair charts not functioning as expected.

Hey [USER] , been a while since I last visited this PR 🙂 . I had opened an issue with the vega-embed repo, but it was closed since I couldn't reproduce it in the vega editor. I finally had some time this week to debug and figure out the issue. 

With the upgrade of `vega-embed`, the default render changed from canvas to SVG (https://github.com/vega/vega-embed/pull/1386), and that's what triggered the bug. You can check that it doesn't manifest with the canvas renderer by replacing:
```python
chart = alt.layer(chart1, chart2)
```
with:
```python
chart = alt.layer(chart2, chart1).properties(
     usermeta={"embedOptions": {"renderer": "canvas"}}
)
```
in the example above.

It turned out that with SVG in an `st.dialog`, path background elements were getting a style that blocks mouse events from reaching the underlying marker, producing the error. I have created the PR: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15191 to fix that and added more details about the issue there.
